source.localDelta: wc-transport builds tokio-tungstenite with rustls-tls-webpki-roots for Android relay TLS; wc-uniffi Bitcoin review JSON includes reviewed execution payload fields and clear-signing display fields for app-side request handling; malformed Bitcoin session requests that cannot be converted into reviewed execution payloads return an unapprovable clear-signing display instead of a generic approval prompt; wc-uniffi session proposal, session update, authentication, and active-session review JSON include user-intent display details, warnings, info, and action-specific explanations for Android; wc-uniffi owns session-authenticate CAIP-122 message construction and signed CACAO JSON wrapping while Android supplies the selected account signature; operation errors include source-chain details for app-side diagnostics; wc-bitcoin derivation path serialization preserves the WalletConnect m/ prefix in session properties; wc-bitcoin accepts syntactically valid Bitcoin-family addresses for BIP-122 testnet interop; wc-bitcoin accepts empty signPsbt signInputs so the wallet can select spendable PSBT inputs; wc-bitcoin summarizes signPsbt unsigned transaction inputs, outputs, decoded destinations, OP_RETURN outputs, and fee visibility for native clear-signing review JSON

verification.nativeConflictPolicy: Do not use broad jniLibs pickFirst rules. Only libc++_shared.so is allowlisted for known SDK duplicates; duplicate WalletConnect native libraries must fail the Android packaging step.
